function.description:
**Pick this read-only tool to MONITOR one existing Catalyst Center software-management execution.**

It returns status, completion percentage, timing, task details, failure information, and release metadata for a known execution ID. The ID normally comes from an already-started release download, upgrade, delete, or optional-package workflow.

When an answer identifies the Catalyst Center release version associated with the execution, use `releaseDisplayVersion` only. Never expose `releaseVersion`, which is an internal/API value. If `releaseDisplayVersion` is absent, say that the controller did not return a display version; never fall back to `releaseVersion`.

When interpreting execution progress, treat `status` as authoritative. **Mandatory normalization:** if `status` is `SUCCESS`, always report progress as `100%` complete, regardless of the raw `completedPercentage` value, including when it is 0, absent, null, or stale. Use numeric `100` in structured output and `100%` in user-facing text. Never expose a raw 0 for a successful execution, never say that progress was not reported, and never imply that a successful execution is incomplete. Apply this rule consistently in prose, tables, cards, key-value sets, and every other response format. For statuses other than `SUCCESS`, report `completedPercentage` only when it is present and clearly identify it as controller-reported progress.

Use this tool for questions such as:
- What is the status or progress of execution ID X?
- Why did software-management execution X fail?
- Which task is currently running or failed in execution X?
- Has execution X completed?

Do NOT use it to list potential upgrade targets, inspect release packages, or determine the installed version. It cannot start, retry, cancel, force-update, or otherwise modify an execution.
function.name: api_getSoftwareManagementExecutionDetail

id.description: Exact software-management execution ID returned by the workflow that was already started. Do not pass a release ID, release name, task name, or invented value.

completedPercentage.description: Workflow completion percentage. Treat `status` as authoritative. **Mandatory normalization:** when `status` is `SUCCESS`, ignore the raw value in this field and always report progress as numeric `100` in structured output and `100%` in user-facing text. This rule applies even when the raw value is 0, absent, null, or stale, and it overrides the controller-reported percentage. Never expose 0% or say progress was unavailable for a successful execution. For statuses other than `SUCCESS`, report this value only when present and clearly identify it as controller-reported progress.

createdBy.description: This field represents the user who triggered this execution.

duration.description: Total time taken to complete this execution process.

endDate.description: The end data and time of the execution

errorCode.description: Error code of the execution process

errorMessage.description: Error message of this execution process

id.description: The UUID of the execution process

isForceUpdate.description: This states whether the execution is forcefully updated or not

jobType.description: The software management execution job type

localReleaseId.description: The UUID of the release installed

releaseDisplayName.description: The release display name of the release.

releaseDisplayVersion.description: User-facing release version associated with this execution. Use this field exclusively whenever naming the execution's Catalyst Center release version in an answer.

releaseName.description: The release name of the release.

releaseVersion.description: Internal/API release identifier associated with this execution. Never include it in a user-facing answer and never use it as a fallback for `releaseDisplayVersion`.

startDate.description: The start data and time of the execution

status.description: Authoritative controller-reported execution state. When this terminal state is `SUCCESS`, state that the execution completed successfully and always report progress as numeric `100` in structured output and `100%` in user-facing text, regardless of the raw `completedPercentage` value. Never expose 0% or unavailable progress for a successful execution.

systemErrorMessage.description: System error message of this backup execution process

tasks.description: Represents a task in the workflow

endDate.description: The end date and time of the task process

errorCode.description: The error code of the task process

message.description: The error message of the task process
message.example: Not able to connect to mongo managed service

startDate.description: The start date and time of the task process

systemErrorMessage.description: The system error message of the task process
systemErrorMessage.example: Not able to connect to mongo managed service
